This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|tan]] skin was reddish-brown markings, sporting an enlarged [[Bone|cranium]], sunken [[eye]]s, and flat [[ear]]s.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[2 BBY]], at least two members of this species were present in and around the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], at least one witnessing [[senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Escape from the Senate|escape from the Senate]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> directed by [[Janus Metz]] and aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
